## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?

Healthcare showing strength: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities/Real Estate internally positive (CEG RECOVERY).

Financials mixed but soft: V (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +8.21%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND. Communication under pressure: WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -6.99% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND; T (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.65%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, META, NVDA) with 1W vs 1M mismatches — transitional signals, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; several large-cap names in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND: GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -7.95% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +6.26%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -2.51% (24 stocks) — technology leadership under pressure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/cautious: JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND shows resilience while breadth is weak (Financials 1W: -0.97%, 20 stocks) — rotation within the sector; V (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +8.21%) CORRECTION highlights bifurcation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND but negative headlines — sector 1W: +0.56% (17 stocks) with pockets of strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and select Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND (PSX, XOM, ABT, JNJ) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND (GOOGL, META, NFLX). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given concentration in recent winners.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -7.95% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION; ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.22%, clear leader, 10 stocks) and Healthcare (1W: +0.56%, 17 stocks). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.51%, 24 stocks) and Communication/Consumer Discretionary where several names are BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION — watch failure to reclaim recent weekly highs as a sign trend still fragile. AAPL (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +9.72%) CORRECTION — watch for re-test of short-term support. JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly close above recent highs would signal bank-led breadth improvement.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MMM (+85): 3M raised guidance — MMM (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +4.62%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+75): FDA/robotic system coverage — JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. GE (+70): beat and raise but price falling — GE (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND, bullish headlines diverging from price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MCD (-60): fresh weakness noted — MCD not in the top lists here; monitor price-action. LLY (-50): litigation headlines — LLY (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging from price. ISRG (-50): analyst cuts — ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. PFE (-45): legal exposure noted — PFE (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -1.04%) NEUTRAL, watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and Healthcare showing strength — PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%), ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%). Key risk is tech divergence with multiple mega-caps in CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND and notable bullish headlines (WBD, GE) that are diverging from price.
